feature_name: Graceful handling of deleted nodes during dispatch
description: Implement error handling in the node dispatch system to prevent crashes when a node is deleted after being queued for dispatch but before the dispatch task executes. This should gracefully handle the scenario where a node no longer exists when the dispatch operation attempts to process it.
functional_requirements: Modify the node dispatch method to check if the node exists before attempting to dispatch it
If the node doesn't exist, log an appropriate warning and exit gracefully without crashing
Add a test that simulates the race condition where a node is deleted between being queued and being dispatched
